Hypersynergism

A quality-of-life mod for Synergism, with information, shortcuts, interface customization and optional automation.

About the mod

Hypersynergism adds information and practical controls to the game: Ambrosia optimization, forge and shop distribution, header editing, remembered interface preferences, save tools and more.

Most features are optional. AutoSing is separately enabled and automates progression; it goes beyond the original mod's strictly QoL scope.

New to Hypersynergism?

  1. Follow the installation guide.
  2. Open the mod's icon, at the top left of the game, to explore settings and Tools.
  3. Use the pencil beside the icon for header customization; new mod modules start in the game's Hidden tray.
  4. Make a backup in Tools before experimenting with strategies or imports.

Help & bug reports

  • Ask on Discord: the HyperSynergism thread on the game's Discord server (the link opens once you've joined the server).
  • Report a bug on GitHub: the issues page.
  • With a bug, send: what you did and what happened, the mod's version (in the mod panel's title), and a backup file: Tools → Backup & Restore → Export to file. It holds your save, the mod's settings and its logs: share it only where you ask for help.
  • First things to try: reload the game; on Steam, Patch & launch again in the loader. The mod doesn't load at all: the installation guide. Last resort, Tools → CLEAR SETTINGS puts every mod setting back to its default: export a backup first.
